identity_basis.basis: software-only shape: observer identity issued by an external certificate authority the producer cannot use

key_control.basis: observer signing key held in a key store only the observer's operator can use

trust_domain.basis: observer runs in a separate host account and failure domain

context.observer_key_basis: published test key, MANIFEST.json keys.observer in vectors-observed-effect; anchored out of band, never read from the record

property.name: observer_independence
property.statement: the observer of this record is independent of the named producer for this claim

note: All three conditions established by evidence in a software-only shape (section 1.1): identity rests on an external basis, no attestation.
